title: A Theory of Policy Optimization in Post-Training: Coverage Collapse and Reference Resets
abstract: arXiv:2611.14467v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy optimization is central to language model post-training, yet principled guidance remains limited. We revisit its theoretical foundations to identify algorithms that learn near-optimal policies using total samples and gradient steps governed by the base model's response coverage, a measure of how readily it generates optimal responses. We call such algorithms coverage-preserving. This guarantee captures the goal of amplifying capabilities accessible through sampling from the base model.   (1) Coverage collapse. REINFORCE, the basis for PPO and GRPO, can drive the probability of optimal responses to near zero, even as reward improves. This coverage collapse stalls optimization, and convergence can require exponentially many steps despite good initial coverage. translated_title: 后训练中策略优化的理论：覆盖坍缩与参考重置
translated_abstract: 策略优化是语言模型后训练的核心，然而其原则性的理论指导仍然有限。我们重新审视其理论基础，旨在识别一类能够学习到近似最优策略的算法，其所需的总样本数和梯度步数由基础模型的响应覆盖度决定——即基础模型生成最优响应的容易程度。我们称这类算法为“保覆盖的”。这一保证刻画了通过从基础模型采样来放大其可及能力的目标。(1) 覆盖坍缩。作为PPO和GRPO基础的REINFORCE算法，即使在奖励提升的同时，也可能将最优响应的概率驱使到接近于零。这种覆盖坍缩会使优化陷入停滞，即便初始覆盖度良好，收敛也可能需要指数级多的步数。即使使用精确梯度，这种失败也会出现，并且在加入对基础模型的KL正则化后依然存在。(2) 参考重置。我们证明，通过反复重置KL参考……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文为语言模型后训练中的策略优化建立了理论框架，证明REINFORCE类算法（PPO和GRPO的基础）即使奖励提升也会发生“覆盖坍缩”、使最优响应概率趋近于零并导致优化停滞，而通过重置KL参考等手段可实现由基础模型响应覆盖度所约束的保覆盖近优学习。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theory of policy optimization in LLM post-training, showing that REINFORCE-style algorithms (the basis of PPO and GRPO) suffer from "coverage collapse"—driving optimal response probabilities to near zero even as reward improves, stalling optimization—and proposes reference resets to achieve coverage-preserving, near-optimal learning governed by the base model's response coverage.
